# Voice ring (`voice-ring`)

A large ring for a voice satellite: idle, listening (follows the level), thinking, speaking, muted and error.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createVoiceRing` (types in `dist/web/home/media-voice/voiceRing.d.ts`): `.mh-voice-ring` (`--medium`; `.is-idle | is-listening | is-transcribing | is-thinking | is-speaking | is-muted | is-error`): the big ring of a voice satellite or a listening screen. The `__ring` (a `<button>` with `onTap`, else hidden from assistive technology) holds a `__halo` that swells with `--_level` while listening, the coloured `__band` (the voice bar's series colours; it turns while transcribing or thinking and beats while speaking) and the `__core` with the phase's icon. Below, the `__label` (a polite live region) and an optional `__detail`. With reduced motion nothing turns or beats; listening shows the level by brightness alone.

```ts
export function createVoiceRing(options: VoiceRingOptions = {}): VoiceRingHandle;

export interface VoiceRingOptions {
  /** Default `idle`. */
  phase?: VoiceRingPhase;
  /** Input level, 0 to 1: the ring swells with it while listening. */
  level?: number;
  /** Status text; defaults to the phase's (`VOICE_RING_LABELS`). */
  label?: string;
  /** A second line: what has been heard so far, or what went wrong. */
  detail?: string;
  /** Default `large`. */
  size?: VoiceRingSize;
  /** Makes the ring a button (start listening, interrupt). Without it the ring is a picture. */
  onTap?: () => void;
}

export interface VoiceRingHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPhase(phase: VoiceRingPhase): void;
  setLevel(level: number): void;
  /** `undefined` goes back to the phase's text. */
  setLabel(label: string | undefined): void;
  setDetail(detail: string | undefined): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createVoiceRing } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const ring = createVoiceRing({ phase: 'idle', onTap: () => void listen() });

/** Listens for four seconds, driving the ring from the microphone level. */
async function listen(): Promise<void> {
  const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).catch(() => null);
  if (!stream) {
    ring.setPhase('error');
    ring.setDetail('The microphone isn’t available.');
    return;
  }
  ring.setPhase('listening');
  ring.setDetail(undefined);
  const audio = new AudioContext();
  const analyser = audio.createAnalyser();
  audio.createMediaStreamSource(stream).connect(analyser);
  const samples = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
  const stopAt = Date.now() + 4000;
  const frame = (): void => {
    analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(samples);
    ring.setLevel(samples.reduce((peak, s) => Math.max(peak, Math.abs(s - 128)), 0) / 128);
    if (Date.now() < stopAt) {
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      return;
    }
    stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    void audio.close();
    ring.setPhase('thinking');
    setTimeout(() => ring.setPhase('idle'), 1500);
  };
  frame();
}

document.body.append(ring.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { VoiceRing } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { VoiceRingPhase } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

/** Where each phase goes next, and after how long. */
const NEXT: Partial<Record<VoiceRingPhase, [VoiceRingPhase, number]>> = {
  listening: ['thinking', 3000],
  thinking: ['speaking', 1500],
  speaking: ['idle', 2500],
};

const DETAIL: Partial<Record<VoiceRingPhase, string>> = {
  listening: 'Turn on the lights in the study',
  speaking: 'Done. The study lights are on.',
};

export function VoiceRingExample() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<VoiceRingPhase>('idle');

  useEffect(() => {
    const next = NEXT[phase];
    if (!next) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setPhase(next[0]), next[1]);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [phase]);

  return (
    <VoiceRing
      phase={phase}
      detail={DETAIL[phase]}
      level={phase === 'listening' ? 0.6 : 0}
      onTap={() => setPhase(phase === 'idle' ? 'listening' : 'idle')}
    />
  );
}
```
